name: Personex
manufacturer: Unknown — suspected Helix Biosystems experimental derivative, black-market adapted
description: Personex is one of the most psychologically devastating compounds in GLMZ's pharmacological underworld — a targeted dissociative agent that does not merely alter consciousness but systematically dismantles the neural architecture of selfhood, temporarily dissolving autobiographical identity, personal values, emotional attachments, and the sense of continuous self. A subject under Personex does not know who they are, does not recognize their own face, cannot access their name, history, loyalties, or beliefs. They are cooperative, suggestible, and terrifyingly compliant — not because they are controlled, but because there is nothing left to resist. The self-architecture reassembles over 8-24 hours, but the memory of having been no one is retained.
effects: Complete temporary dissolution of autobiographical self and identity
Extreme suggestibility and compliance — subject will answer any question, follow any instruction
Suppression of all emotional resistance, loyalty, and values
Full consciousness and sensory function preserved — subject experiences the void in real time
side_effects: The memory of ego-dissolution is fully retained and is universally described as the most terrifying experience of a subject's life
High rates of subsequent depersonalization disorder and existential crisis requiring long-term psychiatric care
Approximately 20% of subjects experience incomplete identity reassembly — some element of selfhood fails to reconstitute
BCI identity anchoring systems fight the compound actively, causing painful neural feedback in augmented subjects
duration: 8-24 hours depending on dose; identity reassembles gradually over the final 2-4 hours
cultural_context: Personex is considered beyond the pale even in GLMZ's ruthless political economy — a line that most operators, even hardened ones, are reluctant to cross. Its use is the signature of entities willing to do anything: certain corporate black-ops divisions, the most brutal the Gray Zone cartels, intelligence operations that no longer care about accountability. Survivors of Personex interrogation rarely speak about it directly. In underground support networks for victims of corpo violence, 'going hollow' is a recognized category of trauma. There are rumors of individuals who use it voluntarily to escape themselves — they are not spoken of with judgment, only sorrow.
story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive emerges from a 'business trip' to a neighboring city subtly wrong — not dramatically, just wrong in small ways, like someone who has had to reconstruct themselves from notes. Her assistant is the first to notice.

A fixer's contact has been Personex-interrogated and reconstituted, but the 20% that didn't come back was their loyalty to the fixer. Now they don't know if the person they're talking to is still their friend or someone wearing their friend's face.

Someone is distributing Personex in the Gray Zone as a recreational drug under a different name, telling buyers it's a dissociative. The death toll isn't from overdose — it's from people who didn't come all the way back.
